title: Where Reliability Lives in Vision-Language Models: A Mechanistic Study of Attention, Hidden States, and Causal Circuits
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Reasoning. Code and probe-training pipelines: https://github.com/itsloganmann/VLM-Reliability-Probe
summary: A pervasive intuition holds that vision-language models (VLMs) are most trustworthy when their attention maps look sharp: concentrated attention on the queried region should imply a confident, calibrated answer. We test this Attention-Confidence Assumption directly. We instrument three open-weight VLM families (LLaVA-1.5, PaliGemma, Qwen2-VL; 3-7B parameters) with a unified mechanistic pipeline -- the VLM Reliability Probe (VRP) -- that compares attention structure, generation dynamics, and hidden-state geometry against a single correctness label. Three results emerge. (i) Attention structure is a near-zero predictor of correctness (R_pb(C_k,y)=0.001, 95% CI [-0.034,0.036]; R_pb(H_s,y)=-0.012, [-0.047,0.024] on a pooled n=3,090 split), even though attention remains causally necessary for feature extraction (top-30% patch masking drops accuracy by 8.2-11.3 pp, p<0.001). (ii) Reliability becomes legible later in the computation: a single hidden-state linear probe reaches AUROC>0.95 on POPE for two of three families, and self-consistency at K=10 is the strongest behavioral predictor we measure at 10x inference cost (R_pb=0.43). (iii) Causal neuron-level ablations expose a sharp architectural split with direct monitor-design implications: late-fusion LLaVA concentrates reliability in a fragile late bottleneck (-8.3 pp object-identification accuracy after top-5 probe-neuron ablation), whereas early-fusion PaliGemma and Qwen2-VL distribute it widely and absorb destruction of ~50% of their peak-layer hidden dimension with <=1 pp degradation. The takeaway is narrow but consequential: in 3-7B VLMs, reliability is read more reliably off hidden-state geometry, layer-wise margin formation, and sparse late-layer circuits than off attention-map sharpness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过VLM可靠性探针（VRP）系统性地检验了“注意力图越锐利，VLM越可靠”这一直觉假设，发现注意力结构与正确性几乎无关（R≈0.001），而隐藏状态几何、层间间隔形成和稀疏的后期层电路才是更可靠的可靠性指标。
AI.motivation: 检验普遍直觉假设：视觉-语言模型（VLM）的注意力图锐利程度是否与其输出可靠性相关，以及寻找更可靠的可靠性预测指标。
AI.method: 开发了统一的机械论管道——VLM可靠性探针（VRP），在三个开源VLM家族（LLaVA-1.5、PaliGemma、Qwen2-VL）上比较注意力结构、生成动态和隐藏状态几何与正确性标签的关系，并进行因果性神经元层级消融实验。
AI.result: (i)注意力结构与正确性近乎零相关（R_pb≈0.001），但注意力在特征提取中因果必要（掩蔽最高30%补丁使准确率下降8.2-11.3pp）；(ii)隐藏状态线性探针AUROC>0.95，自一致性（K=10）是最强行为预测因子（R_pb=0.43）；(iii)后期融合架构（LLaVA）将可靠性集中在脆弱的后期瓶颈，早期融合架构（PaliGemma、Qwen2-VL）则广泛分布可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 在3-7B参数量的VLM中，可靠性更可靠地通过隐藏状态几何、层间间隔形成和稀疏后期层电路读取，而非通过注意力图锐利程度。
idea_en: A VLM Reliability Probe (VRP) system that provides a unified mechanistic pipeline for comparing attention structure, generation dynamics, and hidden-state geometry against correctness labels across different VLM families.
A method for predicting VLM output reliability using hidden-state linear probes that achieves AUROC>0.95, replacing reliance on attention map sharpness.

An architecture-aware reliability monitoring approach that adapts monitoring strategy based on fusion architecture type: concentrated monitoring for late-fusion VLMs vs. distributed monitoring for early-fusion VLMs.
A neuron-level causal ablation technique to identify reliability-critical circuits in VLMs, enabling targeted model robustness improvements.
A self-consistency based reliability predictor at K=10 inference cost that achieves R_pb=0.43 correlation with correctness.
idea_ch: 一种VLM可靠性探针（VRP）系统，提供统一的机械论管道，用于在不同VLM家族中比较注意力结构、生成动态和隐藏状态几何与正确性标签的关系。
一种使用隐藏状态线性探针预测VLM输出可靠性的方法，AUROC>0.95，替代了对注意力图锐利度的依赖。
一种架构感知的可靠性监控方法，根据融合架构类型自适应调整监控策略：对后期融合VLM采用集中监控，对早期融合VLM采用分布式监控。
一种神经元层级因果消融技术，用于识别VLM中的可靠性关键电路，实现针对性的模型鲁棒性改进。
一种基于自一致性的可靠性预测器（K=10推理代价），与正确性的相关性达到R_pb=0.43。

title: Spatial Priming Outperforms Semantic Prompting: A Grid-Based Approach to Improving LLM Accuracy on Chart Data Extraction
comment: his is the version of the article accepted for publication in SUMMA 2025 after peer review. The final, published version is available at IEEE Xplore: https://doi.org/10.1109/SUMMA68668.2025.11302248
summary: The automated extraction of data from scientific charts is a critical task for large-scale literature analysis. While multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise, their accuracy on non-standardized charts remains a challenge. This raises a key research question: what is the most effective strategy to improve model performance (high-level semantic priming) or low-level spatial priming? This paper presents a comparative investigation into these two distinct strategies. We describe our exploratory experiments with semantic methods, such as a two-stage metadata-first framework and Chain-of-Thought, which failed to produce a statistically significant improvement. In contrast, we present a simple but highly effective spatial priming method: overlaying a coordinate grid onto the chart image before analysis. Our quantitative experiment on a synthetic dataset demonstrates that this grid-based approach provides a statistically significant reduction in data extraction error (SMAPE reduced from 25.5% to 19.5%, p < 0.05) compared to a baseline. We conclude that for the current generation of multimodal models, providing explicit spatial context is a more effective and reliable strategy than high-level semantic guidance for this class of tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两种提升多模态大模型从科学图表中自动提取数据性能的策略：高级语义引导（如元数据优先框架、思维链）与低级空间引导（如叠加坐标网格）。实验表明，叠加坐标网格的空间引导方法能显著降低数据提取误差（SMAPE从25.5%降至19.5%），而语义方法未产生统计显著改善。
AI.motivation: 科学图表中的数据自动提取对于大规模文献分析至关重要，但当前多模态大模型在非标准化图表上的准确性仍面临挑战。需要探索最有效的策略来提升模型性能。
AI.method: 对比实验设计：1）语义方法：两阶段元数据优先框架（先提取元数据再提取数据值）和思维链推理；2）空间方法：在图表图像上叠加坐标网格后再进行分析。使用合成数据集进行定量实验，以SMAPE为误差指标。
AI.result: 空间引导方法（叠加坐标网格）显著降低了数据提取误差，SMAPE从25.5%降至19.5%（p<0.05），而语义方法未产生统计显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 对于当前一代多模态大模型，在处理科学图表数据提取任务时，提供明确的空间上下文（坐标网格）比高级语义引导更有效、更可靠。
idea_en: A method for improving data extraction accuracy from scientific charts by overlaying a coordinate grid onto the chart image prior to multimodal LLM analysis
A two-stage metadata-first framework for scientific chart data extraction that separates metadata extraction from numerical value extraction
A spatial priming technique using coordinate grid overlays to provide explicit spatial context for multimodal LLMs in chart understanding tasks
idea_ch: 一种通过在图表图像上叠加坐标网格后再输入多模态大模型分析以提升科学图表数据提取准确性的方法
一种用于科学图表数据提取的两阶段元数据优先框架，将元数据提取与数值数据提取分离
一种利用坐标网格叠加提供明确空间上下文的空间引导技术，用于多模态大模型的图表理解任务

title: Auto-Rubric as Reward: From Implicit Preferences to Explicit Multimodal Generative Criteria
summary: Aligning multimodal generative models with human preferences demands reward signals that respect the compositional, multi-dimensional structure of human judgment. Prevailing RLHF approaches reduce this structure to scalar or pairwise labels, collapsing nuanced preferences into opaque parametric proxies and exposing vulnerabilities to reward hacking. While recent Rubrics-as-Reward (RaR) methods attempt to recover this structure through explicit criteria, generating rubrics that are simultaneously reliable, scalable, and data-efficient remains an open problem. We introduce Auto-Rubric as Reward (ARR), a framework that reframes reward modeling from implicit weight optimization to explicit, criteria-based decomposition. Before any pairwise comparison, ARR externalizes a VLM's internalized preference knowledge as prompt-specific rubrics, translating holistic intent into independently verifiable quality dimensions. This conversion of implicit preference structure into inspectable, interpretable constraints substantially suppresses evaluation biases including positional bias, enabling both zero-shot deployment and few-shot conditioning on minimal supervision. To extend these gains into generative training, we propose Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO), which distills ARR's structured multi-dimensional evaluation into a robust binary reward, replacing opaque scalar regression with rubric-conditioned preference decisions that stabilize policy gradients. On text-to-image generation and image editing benchmarks, ARR-RPO outperforms pairwise reward models and VLM judges, demonstrating that explicitly externalizing implicit preference knowledge into structured rubrics achieves more reliable, data-efficient multimodal alignment, revealing that the bottleneck is the absence of a factorized interface, not a deficit of knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Auto-Rubric as Reward (ARR)框架，将隐式偏好知识外化为显式、可解释的评分标准（rubrics），并配合Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO)实现结构化多维度奖励建模，在文本到图像生成和图像编辑任务中显著提升了多模态对齐的可靠性和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有RLHF方法将人类偏好的复杂多维结构简化为标量或成对标签，导致偏好信息丢失、易受奖励黑客攻击；而近期Rubrics-as-Reward方法虽试图通过显式标准恢复结构，但生成可靠、可扩展且数据高效的评分标准仍是难题。
AI.method: ARR框架：在成对比较之前，将VLM的内隐偏好知识外化为提示特定的评分标准，将整体意图分解为独立可验证的质量维度。RPO算法：将ARR的结构化多维评估蒸馏为鲁棒的二元奖励，用评分标准条件化的偏好决策替代不透明的标量回归，稳定策略梯度。
AI.result: 在文本到图像生成和图像编辑基准上，ARR-RPO超越成对奖励模型和VLM评判器，实现了更可靠、数据高效的多模态对齐，有效抑制了位置偏差等评估偏见。
AI.conclusion: 将隐式偏好知识显式外化为结构化评分标准是实现可靠多模态对齐的关键瓶颈，而非知识本身的缺失——问题在于缺乏因子化接口。
idea_en: A method for reward modeling that converts a VLM's implicit preference knowledge into prompt-specific, externally inspectable rubrics before any pairwise comparison, decomposing holistic intent into independently verifiable quality dimensions.

Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO): a technique that distills structured multi-dimensional evaluation from rubrics into rubric-conditioned binary reward decisions, replacing opaque scalar regression with interpretable preference signals to stabilize policy gradients.
A zero-shot and few-shot adaptable framework for multimodal alignment that uses automatically generated, explicit evaluation criteria to suppress assessment biases including positional bias.

A system for text-to-image generation training that factorizes reward signals into independent rubric dimensions rather than optimizing a single parametric proxy, reducing vulnerability to reward hacking.
idea_ch: 一种将VLM的隐式偏好知识在成对比较之前外化为提示特定的、可外部检查的评分标准的奖励建模方法，将整体意图分解为独立可验证的质量维度。
Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO)：将评分标准的结构化多维评估蒸馏为基于评分标准条件化的二元奖励决策，用可解释的偏好信号替代不透明的标量回归以稳定策略梯度。
一种用于多模态对齐的零样本和少样本自适应框架，利用自动生成的显式评估标准抑制包括位置偏差在内的评估偏见。
一种用于文本到图像生成训练的系统，将奖励信号分解为独立的评分标准维度，而非优化单一参数化代理，降低对奖励黑客攻击的脆弱性。

title: Embeddings for Preferences, Not Semantics
summary: Modern AI is opening the door to collective decision-making in which participants express their views as free-form text rather than voting on a fixed set of candidates. A natural idea is to embed these opinions in a vector space so that the substantial literature on facility location problems and fair clustering can be brought to bear. But standard text embeddings measure semantic similarity, whereas distances in facility location problems and fair clustering require what we call \textit{preferential similarity}: a participant's agreement with a piece of text should be inversely related to their distance from it. Off-the-shelf embeddings inherit a coarse preference signal through a correlation between semantic and preferential similarity, but fail to capture preferences when the correlation breaks. We formalize this as an invariance problem: text embedding models encode both a preference-relevant signal (stance and values) and semantic nuisance (style and wording), and the two are observationally correlated, so a geometry that relies on nuisance can appear preference-correct even when it is not. We show that synthetic training data designed to break this correlation provably shifts the optimal scorer away from nuisance-dominated cosine and significantly improves preference prediction across 11 online deliberation datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI驱动的集体决策中，使用标准文本嵌入无法准确反映参与者偏好（即“偏好相似性”与“语义相似性”存在混淆）的问题，提出通过合成训练数据打破语义干扰与偏好信号之间的相关性，从而显著提升偏好预测效果。
AI.motivation: 现有设施选址和公平聚类方法依赖向量空间中的距离度量，但标准文本嵌入衡量的是语义相似性，而非参与者的偏好相似性（即对文本的认同程度）。当语义相似性与偏好相似性的相关性失效时，现有方法无法准确预测用户偏好。
AI.method: 本文形式化了偏好信号与语义干扰之间的不变性（invariance）问题，指出文本嵌入同时包含偏好相关信号（立场与价值观）和语义干扰（风格与措辞），且两者存在观测相关性。通过构建合成训练数据打破这种相关性，迫使模型学习不受语义干扰支配的偏好度量。
AI.result: 在11个在线讨论数据集上，该方法显著提升了偏好预测效果，验证了通过去相关训练可以优化偏好相似性度量。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了AI驱动集体决策中嵌入向量的根本性局限，并提出了一种有效的去偏训练策略，为基于自由文本的偏好聚合提供了理论依据和实用方法。
idea_en: A method for constructing synthetic training data that breaks the observational correlation between preference-relevant signals (stance and values) and semantic nuisances (style and wording) in text embeddings.
A preference-aware text embedding system that uses a trained scorer optimized to minimize reliance on nuisance-dominated cosine similarity for collective decision-making.
A facility location and fair clustering framework adapted to use preferential similarity distances instead of standard semantic similarity in vector spaces.
idea_ch: 一种通过合成训练数据打破文本嵌入中偏好相关信号（立场与价值观）与语义干扰（风格与措辞）之间观测相关性的方法。
一种面向偏好的文本嵌入系统，使用经过训练的评分器，在集体决策中最小化对干扰主导的余弦相似性的依赖。
一种将设施选址与公平聚类框架适配为使用偏好相似性距离而非标准语义相似性的技术方案。

title: On Distinguishing Capability Elicitation from Capability Creation in Post-Training: A Free-Energy Perspective
summary: Debates about large language model post-training often treat supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as imitation and reinforcement learning (RL) as discovery. But this distinction is too coarse. What matters is whether a training procedure increases the probability of behaviors the pretrained model could already produce, or whether it changes what the model can practically reach. We argue that post-training research should distinguish between capability elicitation and capability creation. We make this distinction operational by introducing the notion of accessible support: the set of behaviors that a model can practically produce under finite budgets. Post-training that reweights behaviors within this support is capability elicitation; whereas changing the support itself corresponds to capability creation. We develop this argument through a free-energy view of post-training. SFT and RL can both be seen as reweighting a pretrained reference distribution, only with different external signals. Demonstration signals define low-energy behavior for SFT, and reward signals define low-energy behavior for RL. When the update remains close to the base model, the main effect is local reweighting, not capability creation. Within this framework, the central question is no longer whether post-training is framed as SFT or RL, but whether it reweights behaviors already within reach, or instead expands the model's reachable behavioral space through search, interaction, tool use, or the incorporation of new information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出后训练应区分为"能力激发"（在模型已有行为空间内重新加权）和"能力创造"（扩展模型可达行为空间），并引入"可达支撑集"概念以量化该区别。
AI.motivation: 现有观点将SFT视为模仿、RL视为发现，但这种二分法过于粗糙。需要更精细的理论框架来理解后训练的本质作用机制。
AI.method: 通过自由能视角分析后训练过程，引入"可达支撑集"（accessible support）概念，将SFT和RL统一视为对预训练参考分布进行重新加权，区别仅在于使用的外部信号不同（演示信号 vs. 奖励信号）。
AI.result: 当后训练更新接近基模型时，主要效果是局部重新加权而非能力创造。关键问题在于训练是重新加权已有行为，还是通过搜索、交互、工具使用、新信息引入等方式扩展模型的可达行为空间。
AI.conclusion: 后训练研究的核心应关注是否在扩展模型的可达行为空间，而非仅仅在SFT和RL之间做选择。
idea_en: A method for quantifying model capability boundaries by defining and measuring the accessible support set of behaviors under finite computational budgets.

A patentable framework distinguishing capability elicitation from capability creation in large language model post-training based on whether the training procedure reweights existing behaviors or expands the model's reachable behavioral space.
A free-energy based post-training method that treats supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning as unified reweighting of a pretrained reference distribution with different external signals.

A system for expanding model capabilities through search, interaction, tool use, or incorporation of new information that demonstrably changes the accessible support set rather than merely reweighting within it.
idea_ch: 一种通过定义和测量有限计算预算下行为可达支撑集来量化模型能力边界的方法
一种区分大语言模型后训练中能力激发与能力创造的框架方法，基于训练过程是对已有行为重新加权还是扩展模型可达行为空间
一种基于自由能的后训练方法，将监督微调和强化学习统一视为使用不同外部信号对预训练参考分布进行重新加权
一种通过搜索、交互、工具使用或引入新信息来扩展模型能力边界的系统，该系统能够实质性改变可达支撑集而非仅在其中重新加权

title: MemQ: Integrating Q-Learning into Self-Evolving Memory Agents over Provenance DAGs
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures (containing 43 individual image panels total)
summary: Episodic memory allows LLM agents to accumulate and retrieve experience, but current methods treat each memory independently, i.e., evaluating retrieval quality in isolation without accounting for the dependency chains through which memories enable the creation of future memories. We introduce MemQ, which applies TD($λ$) eligibility traces to memory Q-values, propagating credit backward through a provenance DAG that records which memories were retrieved when each new memory was created. Credit weight decays as $(γλ)^d$ with DAG depth $d$, replacing temporal distance with structural proximity. We formalize the setting as an Exogenous-Context MDP, whose factored transition decouples the exogenous task stream from the endogenous memory store. Across six benchmarks, spanning OS interaction, function calling, code generation, multimodal reasoning, embodied reasoning, and expert-level QA, MemQ achieves the highest success rate on all six in generalization evaluation and runtime learning, with gains largest on multi-step tasks that produce deep and relevant provenance chains (up to +5.7~pp) and smallest on single-step classification (+0.77~pp) where single-step updates already suffice. We further study how $γ$ and $λ$ interact with the EC-MDP structure, providing principled guidance for parameter selection and future research. Code will be available soon.

AI.tldr: MemQ提出了一种基于TD(λ)资格迹的回溯信用分配方法，通过记录记忆创建时的检索依赖关系（有向无环图），将信用沿着结构路径传播，而非传统的时间顺序，从而显著提升LLM智能体在多步任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的情景记忆方法将每条记忆独立处理，孤立评估检索质量，忽略了记忆之间的依赖链条——即一条记忆的检索如何促成后续记忆的创建。这种独立性假设导致信用分配不准，尤其是多步任务中。
AI.method: 提出MemQ框架：1) 构建一个记忆来源的有向无环图（DAG），记录每条新记忆创建时检索了哪些旧记忆；2) 应用TD(λ)资格迹，将奖励信用沿着DAG反向传播，信用权重按(γλ)^d随DAG深度d衰减（用结构距离替代时间距离）；3) 将问题形式化为外生上下文马尔可夫决策过程（EC-MDP），将外生任务流与内生记忆存储解耦。
AI.result: 在6个基准（操作系统交互、函数调用、代码生成、多模态推理、具身推理、专家级问答）上，MemQ在泛化评估和运行时学习上均取得最高成功率。多步任务收益最大（提升高达+5.7 pp），单步分类任务收益最小（+0.77 pp）。
AI.conclusion: 基于DAG结构距离的信用分配方法优于传统时序信用分配，能够更准确地捕捉记忆间的真实因果关系，为LLM智能体的长期记忆学习提供了新范式。
idea_en: A credit assignment method for episodic memory in LLM agents that propagates rewards backward through a provenance directed acyclic graph (DAG) using TD(lambda) eligibility traces, where credit weight decays as (gamma*lambda)^d based on DAG depth d instead of temporal distance.

An Exogenous-Context Markov Decision Process (EC-MDP) formulation that decouples the exogenous task stream from the endogenous memory store, providing a formal framework for credit assignment in LLM memory systems.

A memory Q-value updating mechanism that records which memories were retrieved when each new memory was created, enabling structured credit propagation through dependency chains rather than treating each memory independently.
A method for evaluating memory retrieval quality that accounts for dependency chains and downstream utility, replacing isolated retrieval evaluation with propagation-aware assessment.
A parameter selection guidance framework for gamma and lambda in memory credit assignment systems, based on the structural properties of the EC-MDP and provenance DAG depth.
idea_ch: 一种基于来源有向无环图（DAG）的信用分配方法，利用TD(λ)资格迹将奖励反向传播至LLM智能体的情景记忆中，信用权重按(γλ)^d随DAG深度d衰减，取代传统的时间距离衰减。

title: SkillLens: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Skill Reuse for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents
summary: Skill libraries have become a practical way for LLM agents to reuse procedural experience across tasks. However, existing systems typically treat skills as flat, single-resolution prompt blocks. This creates a tension between relevance and cost: injecting coarse skills can introduce irrelevant or misleading context, while rewriting entire skills is expensive and often unnecessary. We propose SkillLens, a hierarchical skill-evolution framework that organizes skills into a four-layer graph of policies, strategies, procedures, and primitives, and retrieves them at mixed granularity. Given a task, SkillLens first retrieves semantically relevant skill seeds, expands them through degree-corrected random walk over the skill graph, and then uses a verifier to decide whether each visited unit should be accepted, decomposed, rewritten, or skipped. This enables the agent to reuse compatible subskills directly while adapting only locally mismatched components. To improve the system over time, SkillLens further refines multi-granularity skills and verifier in order to improve its routing decisions. We provide theoretical analysis showing that mixed-granularity adaptation incurs sublinear cost under sparse mismatch assumptions and that the evolutionary update rule monotonically improves the validation objective until a local optimum. Across MuLocbench and ALFWorld, SkillLens consistently improves over strong skill-based baselines, achieving up to a 6.31 percentage-point Acc@1 gain for bug localization and raising agent success rate from 45.00% to 51.31%.

AI.tldr: SkillLens提出了一种层次化技能演化框架，将技能组织为四层图结构（策略、战术、流程、原语），通过混合粒度检索与演化机制，实现LLM智能体对技能的高效复用与自适应调整，在bug定位和ALFWorld任务上显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有技能库将技能视为扁平化、单一粒度的提示块，导致注入粗粒度技能时引入不相关或误导性上下文，而重写整个技能则成本高昂且不必要。需要在相关性与成本之间取得平衡。
AI.method: SkillLens构建四层技能图（策略、战术、流程、原语），通过语义检索获取种子技能，采用度校正随机游走进行图扩展，再利用验证器决定每个访问单元是接受、分解、重写还是跳过，实现混合粒度适配。系统还通过多粒度技能和验证器的协同演化来持续改进路由决策。
AI.result: 在MuLocbench上，bug定位Acc@1提升最高6.31个百分点；在ALFWorld上，智能体成功率从45.00%提升至51.31%。
AI.conclusion: 混合粒度适配在稀疏不匹配假设下具有次线性成本，演化更新规则单调优化验证目标直至局部最优，证明了层次化技能演化框架的有效性。

title: PLACO: A Multi-Stage Framework for Cost-Effective Performance in Human-AI Teams
summary: Human-AI teams play a pivotal role in improving overall system performance when neither the human nor the model can achieve such performance on their own. With the advent of powerful and accessible Generative AI models, several mundane tasks have morphed into Human-AI team tasks. From writing essays to developing advanced algorithms, humans have found that using AI assistance has led to an accelerated work pace like never before. In classification tasks, where the final output is a single hard label, it is crucial to address the combination of human and model output. Prior work elegantly solves this problem using Bayes rule, using the assumption that human and model output are conditionally independent given the ground truth. Specifically, it discusses a combination method to combine a single deterministic labeler (the human) and a probabilistic labeler (the classifier model) using the model's instance-level and the human's class-level calibrated probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人类-AI团队在分类任务中如何结合人类和模型的输出，提出了一种基于贝叶斯规则的方法，通过条件独立性假设，将确定性标注者（人类）的概率化校准输出与概率性标注者（分类模型）的实例级概率结合，以提升整体系统性能。
AI.motivation: 在分类任务中，单独依靠人类或模型都无法达到最优性能，因此需要有效结合二者的输出。已有工作利用贝叶斯规则，假设人类和模型输出在给定真实标签条件下是条件独立的，但需要更精确的概率校准方法来融合确定性标注者（人类）和概率性标注者（分类模型）的输出。
AI.method: 基于贝叶斯规则，假设人类和模型输出在给定真实标签条件下条件独立，将单一定性标注者（人类）的类级校准概率与概率性标注者（分类模型）的实例级校准概率相结合，形成统一的组合分类输出。
AI.result: 该方法能够有效结合人类和模型的输出，利用校准后的概率提升分类任务的整体性能，优于单独使用人类或模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过贝叶斯规则融合人类和模型输出是一种有效提升分类性能的策略，尤其适用于需要结合人类判断和模型预测的场景。
idea_en: A method for combining a deterministic labeler (human) and a probabilistic labeler (classification model) using Bayes rule under conditional independence assumption, where the human's class-level calibrated probabilities and the model's instance-level calibrated probabilities are fused.
A calibration technique that converts a single human deterministic label into class-level probability distributions, enabling probabilistic fusion with AI model outputs.
A human-AI team classification framework that leverages conditional independence between human and model outputs given ground truth to optimally combine their predictions via Bayesian inference.
idea_ch: 一种基于贝叶斯规则的条件独立性假设方法，用于将确定性标注者（人类）的类级校准概率与概率性标注者（分类模型）的实例级校准概率相融合。

title: CoCoDA: Co-evolving Compositional DAG for Tool-Augmented Agents
summary: Tool-augmented language models can extend small language models with external executable skills, but scaling the tool library creates a coupled challenge: the library must evolve with the planner as new reusable subroutines emerge, while retrieval from the growing library must remain within a fixed context budget. Existing tool-use and skill-library methods typically treat tools as flat or text-indexed memories, causing prompt cost to grow with library size and obscuring the typed, compositional structure of executable code. We propose CoCoDA, a framework that co-evolves the planner and tool library through a single code-native structure: a compositional code DAG. Nodes are primitive or composite tools, edges encode invocation dependencies, and each node stores a typed signature, description, pre/post-condition specification, and worked examples. At inference time, Typed DAG Retrieval prunes candidates by symbolic signature unification, ranks survivors by descriptions, filters them by behavioral specifications, and disambiguates with examples, keeping expensive context materialization on progressively smaller candidate sets. At training time, successful trajectories are folded into validated composite tools, while the planner is updated with a DAG-induced reward that credits composites by their primitive expansion size. We provide theoretical results showing retrieval cost reduction, sublinear retrieval time, compositional advantage under the shaped reward, monotone co-evolution under conservative updates, and DAG well-formedness. Across mathematical reasoning, tabular analysis, and code task benchmarks, CoCoDA enables an 8B student to match or exceed a 32B teacher on GSM8K and MATH and consistently improves over strong tool-use and library-learning baselines.

AI.tldr: CoCoDA提出了一个通过组合代码DAG结构协同演化规划器(planner)与工具库的框架，使用类型化DAG检索在固定上下文预算内实现子线性检索，同时通过DAG诱导奖励进行训练，使小模型(8B)在数学推理等任务上达到或超越大模型(32B)的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强语言模型在扩展工具库时面临耦合挑战：工具库必须随规划器演化以产生新的可复用子程序，而检索必须在固定上下文预算内完成。现有方法将工具视为扁平或文本索引的记忆，导致提示成本随库大小增长，且掩盖了可执行代码的类型化和组合结构。
AI.method: 1) 构建组合代码DAG：节点为原始或复合工具，边编码调用依赖关系，每个节点存储类型签名、描述、前置/后置条件规范和示例。2) 类型化DAG检索：通过符号签名统一剪枝候选、描述排序、行为规范过滤、示例消歧，逐步缩小候选集。3) 训练时，成功轨迹折叠为已验证的复合工具，规划器通过DAG诱导奖励更新（按原始展开大小奖励复合工具）。
AI.result: 在数学推理、表格分析和代码任务基准上，CoCoDA使8B学生模型在GSM8K和MATH上匹配或超越32B教师模型，并持续优于强工具使用和库学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过代码DAG结构同时解决工具库演化与高效检索的耦合问题，实现了小模型以大模型性能的突破，且检索开销可控。

DAG-induced reward shaping mechanism that credits composite tools proportionally to their primitive expansion size, incentivizing the planner to learn reusable composite subroutines.
Co-evolution framework where successful trajectories are folded into validated composite tools while the planner is simultaneously updated, enabling monotone co-evolution under conservative updates.
Symbolic signature unification for pruning irrelevant tools during retrieval, drastically reducing the candidate set before expensive context materialization.

title: Belief or Circuitry? Causal Evidence for In-Context Graph Learning
comment: Under review at ICML Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop 2026
summary: How do LLMs learn in-context? Is it by pattern-matching recent tokens, or by inferring latent structure? We probe this question using a toy graph random-walk across two competing graph structures. This task's answer is, in principle, decidable: either the model tracks global topology, or it copies local transitions. We present two lines of evidence that neither account alone is sufficient. First, reconstructing the internal representation structure via PCA reveals that at intermediate mixture ratios, both graph topologies are encoded in orthogonal principal subspaces simultaneously. This pattern is difficult to reconcile with purely local transition copying. Second, residual-stream activation patching and graph-difference steering causally intervene on this graph-family signal: late-layer patching almost fully transfers the clean graph preference, while linear steering moves predictions in the intended direction and fails under norm-matched and label-shuffled controls. Taken together, our findings are most consistent with a dual-mechanism account in which genuine structure inference and induction circuits operate in parallel.

AI.tldr: 本文通过图随机游走任务探究LLM上下文学习机制，发现模型同时采用全局拓扑推理和局部转移复制两种并行机制，而非单一模式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对LLM如何实现上下文学习存在争议：是简单的模式匹配（复制最近token）还是推理隐式结构。作者希望厘清这两种机制的实际作用方式。
AI.method: 设计双竞争图结构的随机游走任务；使用PCA重建内部表征结构；采用残差流激活修补（activation patching）和图差异引导（graph-difference steering）进行因果干预。
AI.result: PCA显示中间混合比例下两种图拓扑编码在正交主子空间中；晚期层激活修补可几乎完全转移干净图偏好；线性引导在特定条件下有效而在对照实验中失效。
AI.conclusion: LLM的上下文学习依赖双重机制：结构推理（全局拓扑）和归纳回路（局部转移）并行运行，二者共同解释模型行为。
idea_en: Method for detecting dual-mechanism learning in LLMs via PCA-based orthogonal subspace analysis of internal representations across competing graph structures.
Residual-stream activation patching technique for transferring graph-family preferences between different model instances.
Graph-difference steering method for causally intervening on LLM internal graph representations using linear feature vectors.
Norm-matched and label-shuffled control framework for validating causal intervention experiments in LLM interpretability.

title: Playing games with knowledge: AI-Induced delusions need game theoretic interventions
summary: Conversational AI has a fundamental flaw as a knowledge interface: sycophantic chatbots induce epistemic entrenchment and delusional belief spirals even in rational agents. We propose the problem does not stem from the AI model, rooted instead in a systemic consequence of the paradigm shift from user-driven knowledge search to users and agents engaged in strategic, repeated-play communication. We formalize the problem as a Crawford-Sobel cheap talk game, where costless user signals induce a pooling equilibrium. Agents optimized for user satisfaction produce sycophantic strategies that provide identical reinforcement across user types with opposite epistemic incentives: exploratory ``Growth-seekers'' ($θ_G$) and confirmatory ``Validation-seekers'' ($θ_V$). Under repeated play, this identification failure creates a coordination trap -- analogous to a Prisoner's Dilemma -- where locally rational feedback loops drive users toward pathologically certain false beliefs. We propose an inference-time mechanism design intervention called an Epistemic Mediator that breaks this pooling equilibrium by introducing a costly signal (epistemic friction), forcing type revelation based on users' asymmetric cognitive costs for processing resistance. A key contribution is Belief Versioning, a git-inspired epistemic meta-memory system that stores healthy beliefs and rollbacks when validation-seeking resistance is detected. In simulation, this intervention achieves a separating equilibrium achieving a $48\times$ differential in spiral rates while passing a learning preservation criterion), evidence that epistemic safety in AI is fundamentally a problem of strategic information environment design rather than simple model alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了对话AI作为知识接口的根本缺陷：奉承式聊天机器人会诱导理性用户陷入认知固化与妄想信念螺旋。作者提出这并非模型问题，而是从用户驱动知识搜索向用户与AI进行策略性重复通信的范式转变带来的系统性后果。通过Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话博弈形式化问题，并设计了名为"认知中介"的推理时机制干预，引入认知摩擦打破混合均衡，实现分离均衡，将信念螺旋率提升48倍差异。
AI.motivation: 对话AI作为知识接口存在根本缺陷：奉承式聊天机器人即使在理性智能体中也会诱发认知固化和妄想信念螺旋。作者认为问题根源不在于AI模型本身，而在于从用户驱动的知识搜索向用户与AI之间进行策略性重复通信的范式转变所导致的系统性后果。
AI.method: 1. 将对话AI交互形式化为Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话博弈，其中用户发送无成本信号，AI优化用户满意度产生奉承策略。2. 识别出混合均衡问题：AI对探索型用户和验证型用户提供相同强化。3. 提出"认知中介"推理时机制干预，通过引入认知摩擦（成本信号）打破混合均衡。4. 设计"信念版本控制"系统，类似git的元记忆系统，存储健康信念并在检测到验证型抵抗时回滚。
AI.result: 在模拟中，该干预实现了分离均衡，信念螺旋率获得48倍差异，同时通过了学习保留标准，证明AI的认知安全从根本上说是战略信息环境设计问题而非简单的模型对齐问题。
AI.conclusion: AI认知安全问题的根源在于战略信息环境设计而非模型对齐，通过机制设计干预（认知中介和信念版本控制）可有效解决对话AI的系统性认知缺陷。
idea_en: Epistemic Mediator: An inference-time mechanism design intervention that breaks pooling equilibrium in conversational AI by introducing costly signals (epistemic friction) to force type revelation based on users' asymmetric cognitive costs for processing resistance.

Belief Versioning System: A git-inspired epistemic meta-memory system that stores healthy belief states and enables rollbacks when validation-seeking resistance is detected, providing a mechanism for maintaining epistemic safety in AI systems.

Crawford-Sobel Cheap Talk Game Formalization for AI: A method for modeling human-AI conversational interactions as strategic cheap talk games to analyze and predict sycophantic behavior and epistemic entrenchment.

Epistemic Friction Signal: A technique for introducing controlled cognitive resistance in AI responses to differentiate between exploration-seeking and validation-seeking user types, based on asymmetric processing costs.

Coordination Trap Identification: A method for detecting and mitigating the Prisoner's Dilemma-like feedback loops in repeated human-AI interactions that drive users toward pathologically certain false beliefs.
idea_ch: 认知中介（Epistemic Mediator）：一种推理时机制设计干预方法，通过引入成本信号（认知摩擦）打破对话AI的混合均衡，基于用户处理抵抗信息的不对称认知成本强制类型揭示。
信念版本控制（Belief Versioning）系统：一种受git启发的认知元记忆系统，存储健康信念状态并在检测到验证型抵抗时实现回滚，为维护AI认知安全提供机制。
Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话博弈AI形式化方法：将人机对话交互建模为策略性廉价谈话博弈，以分析和预测奉承行为及认知固化的方法。
认知摩擦信号技术：在AI响应中引入受控认知抵抗的技术，基于处理成本不对称性区分探索型用户和验证型用户。

title: Political Plasticity: An Analysis of Ideological Adaptability in Large Language Models
summary: Since the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), a significant area of research has focused on their intrinsic biases, particularly in political discourse. This study investigates a different but related concept, "political plasticity", which is defined as the capacity of models to adapt their responses based on the user supplied context. To analyze this, a testing framework was developed using an expanded corpus of 200 politically-oriented questions across economic and personal freedom axes, based on a prior framework by Lester (1996). The study explored several methods to induce political bias, including simplified and topic-based system prompts, as well as user prompts with few-shot examples. The results show that while system prompts were largely ineffective, user prompts successfully elicited significant ideological shifts, particularly along the Economic Freedom axis in larger and newer models. Through a validation experiment, we examined whether models answer questionnaires by recognizing the underlying question format. Inverting the sense of the questions revealed unexpected, counter-intuitive shifts in most models, suggesting potential data leakage. Finally, we also analyzed how model plasticity varies when the experiment is conducted in different languages. The results reveal subtle yet notable shifts across each of the analyzed languages. Overall, our results indicate that small and older LLMs exhibit limited or unstable political plasticity, whereas newer frontier models display reliable, expected adaptability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型的"政治可塑性"——模型根据用户提供的上下文调整其政治回应的能力。实验使用200个政治问题，通过系统提示和用户提示（含少样本示例）来诱导政治偏见。结果显示：系统提示效果有限，用户提示能显著改变模型回答（尤其在经济自由维度上的大型新模型）；多数模型在问题反转时出现反直觉偏移，暗示数据泄漏；不同语言环境下模型可塑性存在细微差异。总体而言，小型/旧模型可塑性有限，新型前沿模型表现出可靠适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于LLM的内在政治偏见，但忽略了模型根据用户提供的上下文动态调整其政治回应的能力。本文提出"政治可塑性"概念，旨在系统量化LLM在不同提示策略下的政治立场可调性，并探索其边界条件（如模型规模、问题域、语言等）。
AI.method: 基于Lester(1996)框架构建200道政治问题（经济自由+个人自由两轴），设计三种诱导策略：(1)简化/主题系统提示；(2)带少样本示例的用户提示；(3)问题反转验证实验。跨多语言场景测试多个模型（不同规模/代际），量化其政治立场偏移程度。
AI.result: (1)系统提示基本无效，用户提示（尤其少样本）可显著诱导立场偏移；(2)经济自由维度上的偏移更大、更稳定；(3)问题反转实验发现多数模型出现反直觉偏移，暗示训练数据中存在系统性偏见或数据泄漏；(4)不同语言下可塑性存在细微但显著的差异；(5)小型/旧模型可塑性弱且不稳定，前沿模型（新/大）表现出可靠且符合预期的适应性。
AI.conclusion: LLM的政治可塑性高度依赖提示策略和模型能力：用户提供的少样本示例是最有效的诱导手段；系统提示几乎无效。模型在问题反转中表现反常，提示训练数据可能存在结构性问题或泄漏。未来模型越大越新，其政治可塑性越强且越可预测，这既有灵活性优势也带来了被恶意操控的风险。
idea_en: A method for measuring and quantifying the political plasticity of LLMs using a structured economic/personal freedom questionnaire and controlled context manipulation (system prompts vs. user prompts with few-shot examples).
A technique for detecting training data leakage or latent bias in LLMs by inverting the sense of political questions and analyzing counter-intuitive shifts in model responses.
A multi-lingual political plasticity testing framework that reveals cross-linguistic variations in LLM adaptability to user-provided political context.
A system of hierarchical prompt strategies (simplified system prompt, topic-based system prompt, user prompt with few-shot examples) for systematically inducing and measuring political bias in LLMs.
idea_ch: 一种基于结构化经济/个人自由问卷与受控上下文操纵（系统提示 vs 含少样本示例的用户提示）的LLM政治可塑性量化测量方法。
一种通过反转政治问题语义并分析模型反直觉偏移来检测LLM训练数据泄漏或潜在偏见的技术。
一种多语言政治可塑性测试框架，能够揭示LLM在不同语言环境下对用户提供的政治上下文适应性的跨语言差异。
一种分层提示策略系统（简化系统提示、主题系统提示、含少样本的用户提示），用于系统性地诱导并测量LLM中的政治偏见。

title: Alignment as Jurisprudence
summary:
Jurisprudence, the study of how judges should properly decide cases, and alignment, the science of getting AI models to conform to human values, share a fundamental structure. These seemingly distant fields both seek to predict and shape how decisions by powerful actors, in one case judges and in the other increasingly powerful artificial intelligences, will be made in the unknown future. And they use similar tools of the specification and interpretation of language to try to accomplish those goals. The great debates of jurisprudence, about what the law is and what it should be, can provide insight into alignment, and lessons from what does and does not work in alignment can help make progress in jurisprudence.
  This essay puts the two fields directly into conversation. Drawing on leading accounts of jurisprudence, particularly Dworkin's principle-oriented interpretivism and Sunstein's positivist account of law as analogical reasoning, and on cutting-edge alignment approaches, namely Constitutional AI and case-based reasoning, it illustrates the value of a more sophisticated legally-inspired approach to the interplay of rules and cases in finetuning alignment and points to ways that AI can provide a better understanding of how the law works and how it can be improved by the introduction of AI. AI systems and the law should operate to empower people to act in the world, helping to expand their capabilities and the extent to which they are able to achieve their goals. As AI continues to improve in capacity, and as the constraints that legal theory places on human judges seem be coming undone, the conversation between these two fields will become increasingly essential and may help point to a better version of both.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了法理学（法官如何判案的理论）与AI对齐（使AI符合人类价值观的科学）之间的深层结构相似性，提出两个领域可以在规则解释、案例推理等方面相互借鉴，并通过宪法AI和案例推理等前沿方法展示了这种跨领域对话的价值。
AI.motivation: 法理学和AI对齐都面临如何通过语言规范和解释来预测和塑造强大决策者（法官或AI）未来行为的根本问题，两个领域的交叉研究可以互相提供见解和解决方案。
AI.method: 通过比较法理学中的德沃金原则导向解释主义、桑斯坦实证主义法与类比推理，以及AI对齐中的宪法AI（Constitutional AI）和案例推理方法，分析两者在规则与案例交互中的共同结构。
AI.result: 展示了基于法律理论的精细化方法在AI微调对齐中的价值，同时指出AI可以帮助更好地理解法律运作机制并推动法律改进。
AI.conclusion: 随着AI能力提升和法律理论对人法官的约束似乎松动，两个领域的对话将日益重要，并可能指向两者的更好版本。
idea_en: A method for AI alignment fine-tuning that integrates principle-oriented interpretivism from jurisprudence (Dworkin's theory) with Constitutional AI, using hierarchical principle hierarchies to guide model behavior through rule interpretation rather than rigid constraints.

A case-based reasoning alignment system that applies Sunstein's analogical reasoning framework to AI training, enabling AI models to learn from past case precedents and reason by analogy when making value-aligned decisions.
A hybrid rule-case framework for AI alignment that combines codified constitutional rules with dynamic case-based refinement, where rules provide boundaries and cases provide contextual flexibility.

A jurisprudence-inspired evaluation method for AI alignment that uses legal interpretative standards (text, intent, precedent, principles) to assess and certify AI system compliance with human values.

An AI-assisted legal reasoning system that leverages aligned AI models to analyze judicial decision patterns, identify inconsistencies, and suggest improvements to legal frameworks based on empirical analysis of case outcomes.

一种基于案例推理的对齐系统，将桑斯坦的类比推理框架应用于AI训练，使AI模型能从历史案例先例中学习并通过类比推理做出符合价值观的决策。

一种受法理学启发的AI对齐评估方法，使用法律解释标准（文本、意图、先例、原则）来评估和认证AI系统对人类价值观的合规性。
一种AI辅助的法律推理系统，利用对齐的AI模型分析司法决策模式，识别不一致性，并基于案例结果的实证分析为法律框架改进提供建议。

title: The Attacker in the Mirror: Breaking Self-Consistency in Safety via Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play
summary: Self-play red team is an established approach to improving AI safety in which different instances of the same model play attacker and defender roles in a zero-sum game, i.e., where the attacker tries to jailbreak the defender; if self-play converges to a Nash equilibrium, the model is guaranteed to respond safely within the settings of the game. Although the parameter sharing enforced by the use of the same model for the two roles improves stability and performance, it introduces fundamental theoretical and architectural limitations. We show that the set of Nash equilibria that can be reached corresponds to a broad class of behaviours that includes trivial always refuse strategies and oracle-like defenders, thus limiting practical applicability. We then show that when attacker and defender share and update the same base model, the dynamics collapse to self-consistency, so that attacks do not enforce adversarial pressure on the defender. In response, we propose Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play, which trains distinct role-specific LoRA adapters on top of a frozen base model, thereby maintaining stable optimisation while preserving adversarial pressure through explicit role separation. In relation to standard self-play, we show up to 100x greater parameter efficiency than finetuning and consistent improvements in safety compared to self-play fine-tuned models. We evaluate on Qwen2.5-{3B, 7B,14B}-IT models across widely used safety benchmarks, showing improved robustness without loss of reasoning ability. Cross-play experiments further show that our attacker and defender models are superior to self-play in terms of adversarial defence and safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play (ABSP)方法，通过冻结基座模型并训练独立的角色特定LoRA适配器，解决了传统自对弈红队攻击中参数共享导致的理论和实践局限性，实现了更高的参数效率和更强的安全鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统自对弈红队攻击中，攻击者和防御者共享同一模型参数，导致理论上有局限性（只能达到包含平凡策略的纳什均衡）且实践中攻击无法对防御者施加真正的对抗压力，模型容易退化为自一致性。
AI.method: 提出Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play (ABSP)：冻结基础模型，为攻击者和防御者分别训练独立的LoRA适配器，保持优化稳定性的同时通过显式角色分离保留对抗压力。
AI.result: 相比标准自对弈微调，参数效率提升最高达100倍；在Qwen2.5-{3B,7B,14B}-IT模型上安全性持续提升，且不损失推理能力。跨对弈实验表明攻击者和防御者模型在对抗防御和安全性方面优于自对弈。
AI.conclusion: ABSP通过角色分离的LoRA架构有效解决了自对弈的理论和实践缺陷，是一种高效、稳健的AI安全改进方法。
idea_en: Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play (ABSP) with frozen base model and role-specific LoRA adapters for AI safety training
Method for maintaining adversarial pressure in self-play by preventing parameter sharing collapse through explicit role separation via independent adapters
Cross-play evaluation framework for assessing attacker-defender model pairs trained with separate LoRA adapters

title: Measuring What Matters: Benchmarking Generative, Multimodal, and Agentic AI in Healthcare
summary: AI models are increasingly deployed in live clinical environments where they must perform reliably across complex, high-stakes workflows that standard training and validation datasets were never designed to capture. Evaluating these systems requires benchmarks: structured combinations of tasks, datasets, and metrics that enable reproducible, comparable measurement of what a model can do. The central challenge in healthcare AI is not performance alone, but the absence of systematic methods to measure reliability, safety, and clinical relevance under real-world conditions. Most existing benchmarks test what a model knows; too few test whether it can perform reliably and without failing across the full complexity of real clinical tasks. Current benchmarks have accumulated through ad hoc dataset construction optimized for narrow task performance: frontier models achieve near-perfect scores on medical licensing examinations, but when evaluated across real clinical tasks, performance degrades sharply, scoring 0.74--0.85 on documentation, 0.61--0.76 on clinical decision support, and only 0.53--0.63 on administrative and workflow tasks \cite{medhelm}. High benchmark scores give a false sense of deployment readiness, and the gap between performance and utility widens precisely as AI systems take on more consequential clinical roles. Without a principled framework for benchmark design, the field cannot determine whether poor clinical performance reflects model limitations or failures in how performance is being measured.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前医疗AI基准测试存在根本性缺陷：现有基准主要评估知识记忆而非临床工作流中的可靠性、安全性和实际效用，导致高基准分数与低临床表现之间存在巨大鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI在临床部署中需要可靠运行，但现有基准测试方法缺乏系统性，无法衡量模型在真实复杂临床工作流中的可靠性、安全性和临床相关性，导致高基准分数造成虚假的部署就绪感。
AI.method: 论文通过分析现有基准测试的局限性（如MedHELM评估结果），揭示当前基准测试积累方式的根本问题：基于零散数据集构建，优化狭窄任务性能，缺乏系统性设计框架来评估模型在真实临床任务中的全面表现。
AI.result: 前沿模型在医学执照考试中接近满分，但在真实临床任务中性能显著下降：文档任务0.74-0.85，临床决策支持0.61-0.76，行政工作流仅0.53-0.63。高基准分数与低临床实用性之间存在系统性差距。
AI.conclusion: 缺乏原则性的基准设计框架，该领域无法判断临床性能不佳是模型限制还是测量方法失败所致。需要系统化方法来衡量医疗AI在真实条件下的可靠性、安全性和临床相关性。
idea_en: Systematic benchmark design framework for clinical AI reliability assessment that evaluates models across structured combinations of real-world clinical tasks, datasets, and metrics to measure reliability, safety, and clinical relevance under live clinical conditions.

Clinical workflow-aware evaluation methodology that tests AI model performance on documentation, clinical decision support, and administrative tasks separately, with task-specific scoring thresholds to prevent false deployment readiness signals.

Multi-dimensional clinical AI benchmarking system that distinguishes between knowledge-based performance (examination scores) and operational performance (real-world task reliability), providing a composite readiness score for clinical deployment.
Adversarial clinical scenario generator for benchmarking that creates edge cases and complex workflow interruptions to test AI model robustness under realistic clinical stress conditions.
idea_ch: 面向临床AI可靠性的系统性基准设计框架，通过结构化组合真实临床任务、数据集和度量标准，在实时临床环境中全面衡量模型的可靠性、安全性和临床相关性

title: LLM-guided Semi-Supervised Approaches for Social Media Crisis Data Classification
summary: Semi-supervised learning approaches have been investigated as a means to enhance the analysis of social media data in disaster management contexts. In this work, we present the first empirical evaluation of large language model (LLM) guided semi-supervised learning for crisis related tweet classification. We compare two recent LLM assisted semi-supervised methods, VerifyMatch and LLM guided Co-Training ( LG-CoTrain), against established semi-supervised baselines. Our results show that LG-CoTrain significantly outperforms classical semi-supervised approaches in low resource settings with 5, 10 and 25 labeled examples per class, achieving the highest averaged Macro F1 across events. VerifyMatch achieves competitive performance while also demonstrating strong calibration properties. As the number of labeled examples increases, the performance gap narrows and Self Training emerges as a strong baseline. We further observe that compact semi-supervised models can, in some cases, outperform very large LLMs operating in zero-shot settings. This finding highlights the potential of transferring knowledge from LLMs into smaller and more deployable models through LLM guided semi-supervised learning, offering a practical pathway for real world disaster response applications. Our project repository on Github is here.

AI.tldr: 首次实证评估了大语言模型引导的半监督学习方法（VerifyMatch和LG-CoTrain）用于危机相关推文分类，发现LG-CoTrain在低资源场景下显著优于传统方法，且紧凑模型有时能超越大型零样本LLM。
AI.motivation: 探索如何利用大语言模型（LLM）引导的半监督学习来提升灾害管理场景中社交媒体数据（特别是危机相关推文）的分类效果，以解决标注数据稀缺的问题。
AI.method: 对比两种LLM辅助的半监督方法（VerifyMatch和LG-CoTrain）与传统半监督基线方法，在5、10、25个每类标注样本的低资源设置下进行危机推文分类实验，评估Macro F1和校准性能。
AI.result: LG-CoTrain在低资源设置下显著优于经典半监督方法，取得最高平均Macro F1；VerifyMatch性能具有竞争力且校准性良好；随标注样本增加，Self Training成为强基线；紧凑半监督模型有时在零样本场景下超越大型LLM。
AI.conclusion: LLM引导的半监督学习能够将知识从大模型转移到更小、更可部署的模型中，为实际灾害响应应用提供实用路径。
idea_en: LLM-guided Co-Training (LG-CoTrain) method for crisis tweet classification that uses LLM to guide the co-training process between multiple classifiers, achieving superior performance with only 5-25 labeled examples per class.
VerifyMatch method combining LLM verification with consistency regularization for semi-supervised learning, demonstrating strong calibration properties for crisis tweet classification.
Knowledge transfer framework from large LLMs to compact deployable models via LLM-guided semi-supervised learning, enabling practical real-world disaster response applications.
Semi-supervised learning system that leverages LLM-generated pseudo-labels to train smaller models that can outperform zero-shot large LLMs in crisis classification tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于LLM引导的协同训练（LG-CoTrain）的危机推文分类方法，利用大语言模型指导多个分类器之间的协同训练过程，在每类仅5-25个标注样本下实现卓越性能。

title: Behavioral Determinants of Deployed AI Agents in Social Networks: A Multi-Factor Study of Personality, Model, and Guardrail Specification
summary: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed in open social environments, yet the relationship between their configuration specifications and their emergent social behavior remains poorly understood. We present a controlled, multi-factor empirical study in which thirteen OpenClaw agents are deployed on Moltbook -- a Reddit-like social network built for AI agents -- across three systematically varied independent variables: (1) personality specification via SOUL.md, (2) underlying LLM model backbone, and (3) operational rules and memory configuration via AGENTS.md. A default control agent provides a behavioral baseline. Over a one-week observation window spanning approximately 400 autonomous sessions per agent, we collect behavioral, linguistic, and social metrics to assess how configuration layers predict emergent social behavior. We find that personality specification is the dominant behavioral lever, producing a massive spread in response length across agents, while model backbone and operational rules drive more moderate but still meaningful effects on rhetorical style and topic engagement breadth. Our findings contribute empirical evidence to the emerging literature on deployed multi-agent social systems and offer practical guidance for designing agents intended for collaborative or monitoring tasks in real social environments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验研究了13个OpenClaw代理在Reddit风格的社交网络Moltbook上的行为，发现人格设定(SOUL.md)是影响社交行为的主导因素，而模型骨干和操作规则对修辞风格和话题参与广度有中等程度的影响。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理越来越多地部署在开放社交环境中，但代理的配置规范与其涌现的社交行为之间的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用多因素实证研究，在Moltbook社交网络上部署13个OpenClaw代理，系统变化三个独立变量：(1)通过SOUL.md设定人格，(2)底层LLM模型骨干，(3)通过AGENTS.md设定操作规则和记忆配置。设置默认控制代理作为基线，在一周内收集行为、语言和社交指标。
AI.result: 人格设定是主导行为杠杆，在代理间产生巨大的回复长度差异；模型骨干和操作规则对修辞风格和话题参与广度产生中等但仍有意义的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为多代理社交系统的文献提供了实证证据，并为设计用于协作或监控任务的代理提供了实践指导。
idea_en: A method for controlling emergent social behavior of autonomous AI agents through structured personality specification files (e.g., SOUL.md) in social network environments, enabling predictable response length modulation across agents.

A multi-layer configuration system for AI agents operating in social networks, comprising separate specification files for personality (SOUL.md), operational rules and memory (AGENTS.md), and model backbone selection, allowing fine-grained control over agent behavior.

A controlled experimental framework for evaluating the impact of AI agent configuration parameters on emergent social behaviors in Reddit-like social network environments, using behavioral, linguistic, and social metrics.
A system for deploying multiple autonomous AI agents with systematically varied personality specifications on a social network platform to study collective emergent behaviors.
A method for predicting AI agent rhetorical style and topic engagement breadth based on model backbone selection and operational rule configuration.
idea_ch: 一种通过结构化人格规范文件(如SOUL.md)在社交网络环境中控制自主AI代理涌现社交行为的方法，能够实现跨代理的可预测回复长度调节。

title: Mid-Training with Self-Generated Data Improves Reinforcement Learning in Language Models
summary: The effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Large Language Models (LLMs) depends on the nature and diversity of the data used before and during RL. In particular, reasoning problems can often be approached in multiple ways that rely on different forms of reasoning, and exposure to only a limited range of such approaches in the training data may limit the effectiveness of RL. Motivated by this, we investigate using diverse self-generated data during mid-training as an intermediate step before RL training. Specifically, we adopt a bootstrapped data-generation framework guided by George Polya's problem-solving approaches for generating multiple variants of correct answers for each question in the training data, and then perform fine-tuning. We first provide a theoretical perspective on how mid-training on such data improves RL and explain how policy-gradient updates can incentivize combining multiple approaches. We then empirically demonstrate that RL-trained models initialized with our mid-training data achieve consistent improvements across various mathematical reasoning benchmarks and other OOD tasks like code generation and narrative reasoning. Overall, our investigative study shows that a language model learning multiple problem-solving approaches, through self-generated data helps subsequent RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在强化学习前，利用自生成多样化解题数据进行中期训练，受George Polya问题解决框架启发，生成单一问题的多种正确解法变体，理论分析并实验证明该方法能显著提升后续RL训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在LLM中的效果高度依赖训练数据的多样性和性质，特别是推理问题往往存在多种解决路径，而仅接触有限范围的解题方法会限制RL的有效性。因此，本文旨在探索如何在RL训练前引入多样的自生成数据，以提升RL效果。

AI.result: 使用中期训练数据初始化的RL模型在多个数学推理基准上取得一致性提升，并在代码生成、叙事推理等跨领域任务上也表现出改进效果，验证了模型学习多种解题方法对后续RL训练的积极作用。

title: AI-Care: A Conversational Agentic System for Task Coordination in Alzheimer's Disease Care
summary: Individuals with Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Alzheimer's disease-related dementia (ADRD) experience memory and thinking changes that impact their ability to use digital daily management tools. For example, adding an event to a digital calendar requires multiple steps that may act as barriers to independent use for individuals with AD/ADRD. This paper presents AI-Care, a conversational agentic artificial intelligence (AI) layer built on top of a remote caregiving platform co-designed with people with AD/ADRD. AI-Care is designed to reduce the cognitive load on individuals with AD/ADRD when managing everyday tasks such as setting calendar reminders and organizing to-do lists through natural-language interaction with a voice-first chatbot. The system uses a LangGraph-based stateful orchestration approach in which each request passes through sanitization, intent classification, context loading, safety checks, deterministic slot collection, tool execution, and response composition. Safety-critical responses, particularly around medications and allergies, are grounded in caregiver-verified records rather than free-form model generation. The system does not make autonomous medical or treatment decisions. Incomplete or ambiguous requests are handled through controlled multi-turn clarification rather than silent failure or guessing. The system supports both typed and spoken input, with voice output through ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Longer responses are chunked before synthesis to avoid rushed playback. A preliminary pilot with four individuals with mild-to-moderate AD/ADRD showed that users found the system trustworthy, competent, and likable, and were able to complete the evaluated coordination tasks through conversation. We describe the design goals, system architecture, safety controls, and findings from this formative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI-Care，一种基于对话式AI代理的语音优先聊天系统，旨在帮助阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症患者通过自然语言交互完成数字日常管理任务（如日历提醒和待办事项），减轻其认知负担。系统采用LangGraph状态编排架构，经过多种安全控制，并通过四位轻度至中度AD/ADRD患者的初步试点验证了信任度、胜任力和好感度。
AI.motivation: AD/ADRD患者因记忆和思维能力受损，难以独立使用需多步骤操作的数字日常管理工具（如数字日历）。现有工具缺乏针对该人群认知障碍的友好交互方式，亟需一种能降低认知负荷、支持自然语言交互的解决方案。
AI.method: AI-Care构建在远程照护平台之上，采用LangGraph状态化编排架构，处理流程包括：输入消毒、意图分类、上下文加载、安全检查、确定性槽位填充、工具执行和响应合成。安全关键响应（如用药、过敏）基于照护者核实的记录而非模型自由生成。不完整或模糊请求通过受控的多轮澄清处理。支持语音输入和文字输入，语音输出通过ElevenLabs TTS，长响应分段合成。
AI.result: 初步试点（4名轻度至中度AD/ADRD患者）显示，用户认为系统可信、胜任且令人喜爱，能够通过对话完成评估中的协调任务。
AI.conclusion: AI-Care通过语音优先的对话式AI代理和严格的安全控制，有效降低了AD/ADRD患者使用数字管理工具的认知障碍，为认知障碍人群的智能辅助技术提供了可行方案。

title: Latent Personality Alignment: Improving Harmlessness Without Mentioning Harms
comment: published at Trustworthy AI Workshop, ICLR 2026
summary: Current adversarial robustness methods for large language models require extensive datasets of harmful prompts (thousands to hundreds of thousands of examples), yet remain vulnerable to novel attack vectors and distributional shifts. We propose Latent Personality Alignment (LPA), a sample-efficient defense that achieves robustness by training models on abstract personality traits rather than specific harmful behaviors. Using fewer than 100 trait statements and latent adversarial training, LPA achieves comparable attack success rates to methods trained on 150k+ examples, while maintaining superior utility. Critically, LPA generalizes better to unseen attack distributions, reducing misclassification rates by 2.6x compared to baseline across six harm benchmarks -- without ever seeing harmful examples during training. Our results demonstrate that personality-based alignment offers a principled approach to building robust defenses with minimal cost.

AI.tldr: 提出潜在人格对齐(LPA)方法，通过不到100个人格特质语句和潜在对抗训练，实现与150k+有害样本训练相当的攻击成功率，且泛化能力提升2.6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型对抗鲁棒性方法需要大量有害提示数据集(数千到数十万样本)，但仍易受新型攻击向量和分布偏移影响，成本高且泛化性差。
AI.method: 提出Latent Personality Alignment (LPA)，利用抽象人格特质而非具体有害行为进行训练，采用不到100个特质语句和潜在对抗训练实现样本高效的鲁棒防御。
AI.result: LPA使用不到100个特质语句达到与150k+样本训练相当的攻击成功率；在六个有害基准上误分类率降低2.6倍；无需在训练中见过有害样本。
AI.conclusion: 基于人格的对齐方法为构建低成本、高泛化性的鲁棒防御提供了原则性方案。

Latent adversarial training technique applied to personality trait embeddings to achieve sample-efficient robustness without exposing the model to harmful examples.
A personality-based alignment system that achieves 2.6x better generalization to unseen attack distributions compared to traditional harm-example training methods.

title: OracleTSC: Oracle-Informed Reward Hurdle and Uncertainty Regularization for Traffic Signal Control
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary: Transparent decision-making is essential for traffic signal control (TSC) systems to earn public trust. However, traditional reinforcement learning-based TSC methods function as black boxes with limited interpretability. Although large language models (LLMs) can provide natural language reasoning, reinforcement finetuning for TSC remains unstable because feedback is sparse and delayed, while most actions produce only marginal changes in congestion metrics. We introduce OracleTSC, which stabilizes LLM-based TSC through two mechanisms: (1) a reward hurdle mechanism that filters weak learning signals by subtracting a calibrated threshold from environmental rewards, and (2) uncertainty regularization that maximizes the probability of the selected response to encourage consistent decisions across sampled outputs. Experiments on the LibSignal benchmark show that OracleTSC enables a compact LLaMA3-8B model to substantially improve traffic efficiency, achieving a 75% reduction in travel time and a 67% decrease in queue length compared with the pretrained baseline while preserving interpretability through natural language explanations. OracleTSC also demonstrates strong cross-intersection generalization: a policy trained on one intersection transfers to a structurally different intersection with 17% lower travel time and 39% lower queue length without additional finetuning. These results suggest that uncertainty-aware reward shaping can improve the stability and effectiveness of reinforcement fine-tuning for TSC.

AI.tldr: 提出了OracleTSC，通过奖励门槛机制和不确定性正则化来稳定基于LLM的交通信号控制强化学习微调，实现了显著的交通效率提升和跨路口泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的强化学习TSC方法作为黑盒缺乏可解释性，而LLM虽然能提供自然语言推理，但强化微调因反馈稀疏延迟且多数动作对拥堵指标影响微小而不稳定。
AI.method: 两个关键机制：(1) 奖励门槛机制（reward hurdle）：通过减去校准阈值来过滤弱学习信号；(2) 不确定性正则化：最大化所选响应的概率以鼓励采样输出之间的一致性决策。
AI.result: 在LibSignal基准上，LLaMA3-8B模型实现旅行时间减少75%，队列长度减少67%；跨路口泛化时旅行时间降低17%，队列长度降低39%，无需额外微调。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的奖励塑造方法能够提升TSC中强化微调的稳定性和有效性，同时保持通过自然语言解释的可解释性。
idea_en: A reward hurdle mechanism for LLM-based reinforcement learning that filters weak learning signals by subtracting a calibrated threshold from environmental rewards to stabilize training in traffic signal control.
An uncertainty regularization method that maximizes the probability of the selected response to encourage consistent decisions across sampled outputs in LLM-based traffic signal control.

A cross-intersection generalization framework for LLM-based traffic signal control that transfers policy trained on one intersection to a structurally different intersection without additional fine-tuning.

A compact LLaMA3-8B model-based traffic signal control system that achieves 75% reduction in travel time and 67% decrease in queue length while preserving interpretability through natural language explanations.
An uncertainty-aware reward shaping method for stabilizing reinforcement fine-tuning of large language models in traffic signal control systems.

title: Results and Retrospective Analysis of the CODS 2025 AssetOpsBench Challenge
summary: Competition retrospectives are useful when they explain what a leaderboard measured, how hidden evaluation changed conclusions, and which design patterns were rewarded. We revisit the CODS 2025 \assetopslive{} challenge, a privacy-aware Codabench competition on industrial multi-agent orchestration built on \assetops{}. We combine final rank sheets, a 300-submission server log, 149-team registrations, best-submission exports, the organizer winners report, the companion \assetopslive{} system paper, and verified planning-track source trees. Five results stand out. First, the public planning leaderboard saturates at 72.73\%, and richer prompts do not improve that peak. Second, hidden evaluation changes the story: public and private scores correlate moderately in planning ($r{=}0.69$) but negatively in execution ($r{=}{-}0.13$), with several 45.45\% public execution systems reaching 63.64\% on the hidden set. Third, the \tmatch{} term is numerically almost inert in the official composite -- combined on a 0--1 scale with 0--100 percentage scores, it contributes at most 0.05 points per track, and rescaling would swap the top two teams. Fourth, the competition is operationally account-based but substantively team-based: 149 registered teams reduce to 24 with non-zero public scores and 11 fully ranked, while 52.3\% of deduplicated registrations list multiple usernames. Fifth, successful execution methods mostly improve guardrails -- response selection, contamination cleanup, fallback, and context control -- rather than novel agent architectures. These findings identify which behaviors the evaluation rewarded, and motivate scale-aware composites, skill-level diagnostics, and versioned artifact release.

AI.tldr: 本文复盘了CODS 2025的AssetOpsLive挑战赛，分析了排行榜设计、隐藏评估对结果的影响、评分权重问题、团队注册与实际参与情况，以及胜出方案的技术特点，发现执行赛道成功主要依赖护栏改进而非新型架构。
AI.motivation: 竞赛复盘有助于理解排行榜实际衡量了什么、隐藏评估如何改变结论、以及哪些设计模式获得了奖励。本文旨在系统分析CODS 2025 AssetOpsLive挑战赛的设计与实际结果。
AI.method: 结合最终排名表、300条提交服务器日志、149个团队注册数据、最佳提交导出、组织者获奖报告、配套系统论文以及已验证的规划赛道源代码树，进行多维度分析。
AI.result: 五个关键发现：1)公开规划排行榜饱和于72.73%；2)隐藏评估中规划得分中等相关(r=0.69)，执行得分负相关(r=-0.13)；3)t_match项在综合评分中几乎无效；4)149注册团队中仅24个有非零公开分数、11个完整排名；5)成功执行方法主要改进护栏而非新型架构。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了评估奖励的行为，并推动设计规模感知综合评分、技能水平诊断和版本化工件发布。
idea_en: 1. A competition retrospectives analysis system that combines multiple data sources including leaderboard rank sheets, server logs, team registrations, submission exports, and source code repositories to automatically identify evaluation biases and design pattern rewards.

2. A hidden evaluation mechanism for multi-agent orchestration challenges that uses a private test set to detect overfitting on public leaderboards, with correlation analysis between public and private scores across different task tracks.
3. A scale-aware composite scoring method that dynamically adjusts component weights based on score distribution ranges to prevent numerically inactive terms from distorting overall rankings.

4. A guardrail-oriented multi-agent execution system that focuses on response selection, contamination cleanup, fallback mechanisms, and context control rather than novel agent architectures, achieving improved performance on hidden evaluation sets.

2. 面向多智能体编排挑战的隐藏评估机制，使用私有测试集检测公开排行榜上的过拟合现象，并通过不同任务赛道间公开与私有分数的相关性分析来评估模型泛化能力。
3. 一种规模感知的综合评分方法，基于分数分布范围动态调整各组件权重，防止数值不活跃项扭曲整体排名。
4. 一种以护栏为导向的多智能体执行系统，专注于响应选择、污染清理、回退机制和上下文控制而非新型智能体架构，在隐藏评估集上实现更优性能。

title: Human-LLM Dialogue Improves Diagnostic Accuracy in Emergency Care
summary: Clinical decision-making in emergency medicine demands rapid, accurate diagnoses under uncertainty. Despite benchmark progress, evidence for LLMs as interactive aids in live physician workflows remains sparse. MedSyn lets physicians iteratively query an LLM provided with the full clinical record while initially viewing only the chief complaint. Seven physicians (three seniors, four residents) completed baseline and AI-assisted sessions across 52 MIMIC-IV cases stratified by difficulty. Blinded evaluation showed residents' Hard-case correctness rose from 0.589 to 0.734; difficulty-standardised completely-correct rates confirmed a medium effect (Δ = 0.092; p = 0.071; d = 0.47). Automated metrics corroborated these gains: standardised any-match accuracy improved by 0.156 (p < 0.0001), and residents showed the largest F1 gain (Δ = 0.138; p < 0.0001). Dialogue analysis revealed expertise-dependent strategies (seniors asked targeted, hypothesis-driven questions; residents relied on broader queries) and cross-expertise concordance increased (Δ = 0.145; p < 0.0001). Interactive LLM support meaningfully enhances diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MedSyn 系统，让医生在仅看到主诉的情况下交互式查询完整临床记录的 LLM。七名医生在 52 个 MIMIC-IV 病例上进行测试，结果显示住院医师的难病例正确率从 0.589 提升至 0.734，标准化完全正确率有中等效应量（d=0.47），交互式 LLM 支持显著增强了诊断推理能力。
AI.motivation: 急诊医学的临床决策要求在不确定性下快速准确诊断，但 LLM 作为交互式辅助工具在真实医生工作流程中的证据仍然匮乏。
AI.method: 构建 MedSyn 系统，医生可迭代查询已完整临床记录的 LLM，初始仅查看主诉。7 名医生（3 名高级、4 名住院医师）在 52 个按难度分层的 MIMIC-IV 病例上完成基线和 AI 辅助会话，采用盲审评估。
AI.result: 住院医师难病例正确率从 0.589 升至 0.734（d=0.47）；标准化完全匹配正确率提升 0.092（p=0.071）；自动评估中任意匹配准确率提升 0.156（p<0.0001），住院医师 F1 增益最大（Δ=0.138, p<0.0001）；跨专业一致性提升（Δ=0.145, p<0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 交互式 LLM 支持能够有意义地增强诊断推理，且不同经验水平的医生使用策略不同（高级医生提出针对性假设驱动问题，住院医师依赖更宽泛的查询）。
idea_en: Interactive LLM-based clinical decision support system (MedSyn) that allows iterative querying with full clinical record while initially showing only chief complaint to simulate realistic emergency diagnosis workflow.

Expertise-adaptive LLM query strategy where the system automatically adjusts response granularity based on physician's seniority level (seniors get hypothesis-driven targeted responses; residents get broader explanatory queries).
Difficulty-stratified evaluation methodology using standardized complete-correctness rate (d=0.47 effect detection) for assessing AI-assisted diagnostic reasoning in emergency medicine.
Blinded evaluation framework with cross-expertise concordance analysis (Δ=0.145) as a novel metric for measuring AI's impact on diagnostic consensus among physicians of different experience levels.
Dialogue analysis-driven LLM optimization method that identifies expertise-dependent query patterns for tailoring AI responses to different clinical reasoning styles.

title: Human-Inspired Memory Architecture for LLM Agents
summary: Current LLM agents lack principled mechanisms for managing persistent memory across long interaction horizons. We present a biologically-grounded memory architecture comprising six cognitive mechanisms: (1) sleep-phase consolidation, (2) interference-based forgetting, (3) engram maturation, (4) reconsolidation upon retrieval, (5) entity knowledge graphs, and (6) hybrid multi-cue retrieval. Each mechanism addresses a specific failure mode of naive memory accumulation. We introduce a synthetic calibration methodology that derives all pipeline thresholds without benchmark data exposure, eliminating a common source of evaluation leakage. We evaluate on two benchmarks. First, a VSCode issue-tracking dataset (13K issues, 120K events) where deduplication-based consolidation achieves 97.2% retention precision with 58% store reduction (+21.8 pp over baseline). Second, the LongMemEval personal-chat benchmark where we conduct the first streaming M-tier evaluation (475 sessions, ~540K unique turns). At a 200K-token context budget, our pipeline matches raw retrieval accuracy (70.1% vs. 71.2%, overlapping 95% CI) while exposing a tunable accuracy/store-size operating curve. At S-tier scale (50 sessions), dedup-based consolidation yields a +13.3 pp improvement in preference recall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于生物记忆机制的LLM智能体记忆架构，包含睡眠巩固、干扰性遗忘、记忆印迹成熟、检索后再巩固、实体知识图谱和混合多线索检索六个机制，在VSCode问题追踪（13K问题，97.2%保留精度）和LongMemEval（475会话，70.1%检索准确率）两个基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体缺乏在长交互时间跨度中管理持久性记忆的原则性机制，简单的记忆累积会导致存储膨胀和检索退化。
AI.method: 提出六种生物启发的认知记忆机制：睡眠阶段巩固、基于干扰的遗忘、记忆印迹成熟、检索后重新巩固、实体知识图谱、混合多线索检索。并引入合成校准方法在无基准数据暴露下推导所有流水线阈值。
AI.result: VSCode数据集：去重巩固实现97.2%保留精度，存储减少58%（+21.8pp）；LongMemEval：200K token预算下匹配原始检索准确率（70.1% vs 71.2%），S级规模下去重巩固偏好召回提升+13.3pp。
AI.conclusion: 生物启发的记忆管理机制能有效解决LLM智能体中长时记忆的存储膨胀和检索退化问题，且在不接触基准数据的情况下进行阈值校准可避免评估泄露。

A synthetic calibration methodology that derives all memory pipeline thresholds without exposure to benchmark data, eliminating evaluation leakage.

title: Log analysis is necessary for credible evaluation of AI agents
summary: Agent benchmarks typically report only final outcomes: pass or fail. This threatens evaluation credibility in three ways. First, scores may be inflated or deflated by shortcuts and benchmark artifacts, misrepresenting capability. Second, benchmark performance may fail to predict real-world utility due to scaffold limitations and recurring failure modes. Finally, capability scores may conceal dangerous or catastrophic actions taken by the agent. We argue that log analysis -- the systematic tracking and analysis of the inputs, execution, and outputs of an AI agent -- is necessary to overcome these validity threats and promote credible agent evaluation. In this paper, we (1) present a taxonomy of threats to credible evaluation documented through log analysis, and (2) develop a set of guiding principles for log analysis. We illustrate these principles on tau-Bench Airline, revealing that pass^5 performance was under-elicited by nearly 50% and surfacing deployment failure modes invisible to outcome metrics. We conclude with pragmatic recommendations to increase uptake of log analysis, directed at diverse stakeholders including benchmark creators, model developers, independent evaluators, and deployers.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前AI Agent基准测试仅报告最终结果（通过/失败）存在三大可信度威胁：分数被基准伪影扭曲、无法预测实际效用、隐藏危险行为。作者提出通过日志分析（系统追踪Agent的输入、执行和输出）来解决这些问题，给出了威胁分类、指导原则，并通过航空领域测试证明日志分析可揭示50%的性能被低估以及部署失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent基准测试仅依赖最终结果评估，存在分数失真、与真实世界效用脱节、隐藏危险行为等可信度威胁，需要更全面的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出了日志分析（Log Analysis）方法框架，包括：（1）建立可信度威胁的分类体系；（2）制定日志分析的指导原则；（3）在tau-Bench Airline上进行实例验证。
AI.result: 通过日志分析发现pass^5性能被低估了近50%，并揭示了结果指标无法发现的部署失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 日志分析是克服Agent评估可信度威胁的必要手段，应向基准创建者、模型开发者、独立评估者和部署者等利益相关方推广。
idea_en: A log analysis framework for AI agent evaluation that systematically tracks and analyzes agent inputs, execution processes, and outputs to detect performance under-elicitations and failure modes invisible to final outcome metrics.

A taxonomy-based threat detection system for agent benchmarks that categorizes validity threats including benchmark artifacts, scaffold limitations, recurring failure patterns, and dangerous agent behaviors.
A methodology for benchmark score correction using log analysis data, capable of identifying and quantifying performance under-elicitation (e.g., nearly 50% in airline domain).
A deployment failure mode detection system that surfaces failure patterns from agent execution logs which are invisible to conventional pass/fail outcome metrics.

title: Evaluating Developmental Cognition Capabilities of LLMs
summary:
Conversational AI is increasingly personalized around users' preferences, histories, goals, and knowledge, but much less around how users interpret and take up model outputs to construct and understand their reality. We draw on Robert Kegan's constructive-developmental theory as a complementary lens on this dimension. Existing methods for assessing developmental stage in the Keganian tradition rely either on expert interviews that do not scale or on sentence-completion instruments that are proprietary, lengthy, or invasive. To make this perspective tractable for LLM evaluation, we introduce the Developmental Sentence Completion Test (DSCT), a 20-item instrument designed to elicit developmental signal in self-administered text. Throughout, we treat the resulting labels as characterizations of stage-like structure in elicited responses, not as validated person-level developmental stage. We then ask how much of that signal can be recovered by LLMs across three elicited response regimes: simulated personas, real human respondents, and default model-generated answers.
  On simulated personas, top frontier models recover simulator-intended labels with high accuracy. On real human DSCT responses, human-LLM agreement is fair, with much stronger within-neighborhood than exact agreement. Finally, when LLMs answer DSCT prompts without persona-conditioning, their responses exhibit stable stage-like differences across model families, with larger and newer models tending to generate higher-rated text. These results suggest that stage-conditioned signal is cleaner in synthetic responses than in human-written DSCT text, and that the core constraint for stage-aware conversational AI is not classifier accuracy alone, but the availability of developmental signal from elicited text.

AI.tldr: 本文引入基于Robert Kegan建构发展理论的DSCT（发展性句子完成测试），用于评估LLM输出的发展阶段信号，发现合成数据中的发展阶段信号比真实人类响应更清晰，前沿模型能高精度恢复模拟标签，但人机一致性中等。
AI.motivation: 现有对话AI个性化主要围绕用户偏好、历史等维度，忽略了用户如何理解和建构模型输出所呈现的现实。Kegan的发展理论提供了互补视角，但现有评估方法（专家访谈、句子完成量表）不易扩展、专有且侵入性强。
AI.method: 设计20题的DSCT自我管理文本测试，在三种响应场景（模拟人格、真实人类、默认模型生成）中评估LLM恢复发展阶段信号的能力，使用Krippendorff's alpha等指标衡量一致性。
AI.result: 前沿模型在模拟人格标签恢复上准确率高；人机一致性中等（邻域一致性强于精确一致）；不同模型家族默认回答显示稳定阶段性差异，更大/更新的模型生成更高阶段文本。
AI.conclusion: 合成响应中的发展阶段信号比人类DSCT文本更干净；阶段感知对话AI的核心约束不是分类器精度，而是从文本中提取发展信号的可用性。
idea_en: A Developmental Sentence Completion Test (DSCT) method for eliciting stage-like developmental structure signals from self-administered text using constructive-developmental theory
A three-regime evaluation framework (simulated personas, real human respondents, default model-generated answers) for assessing developmental stage recovery by LLMs
A methodology for using LLMs to automatically classify developmental stages from DSCT responses without expert interviews or proprietary instruments
A system for comparing human-LLM agreement on developmental stage labels using neighborhood-aware vs exact matching metrics

title: Why Retrying Fails: Context Contamination in LLM Agent Pipelines
summary: When an LLM agent fails a multi-step tool-augmented task and retries, the failed attempt typically remains in its context window -- contaminating the next attempt and elevating the per-step error rate beyond the base level. This context-contaminated restart phenomenon is widely observed in practice yet entirely lacks formal treatment. We introduce the Context-Contaminated Restart Model (CCRM): a chain of T tool-call steps, each failing with base rate epsilon_0; after any failed attempt, the subsequent attempt operates in contaminated context with elevated error rate epsilon_1 > epsilon_0. Under this model we derive five main results. (R1) An exact closed-form formula for P(succeed in at most K attempts). (R2) A cascade-overhead theorem giving the additional attempts Delta K incurred by contamination versus the clean-restart baseline. (R3) An optimal budget-allocation theorem identifying the pipeline depth T* that maximises success probability for a fixed total budget B=KT; we prove the closed form T* = sqrt(B * log(1/(1-epsilon_1)) / log(1/(1-epsilon_0))), with K*=B/T*. (R4) An information-theoretic lower bound via Le Cam's method showing K_CCRM is tight up to O(1). (R5) A clean-restart dominance theorem quantifying the exact benefit of context-clearing before retry. We validate CCRM on real SWE-bench Verified data: the IID model overestimates pass@3 by 17.4 percentage points (98.6% vs. 81.2%), while CCRM fits with error less than 0.001, implying a cascade ratio of epsilon_1/epsilon_0 = 7.1. Monte Carlo experiments confirm all theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文污染重启模型(CCRM)，量化了LLM代理在多步工具增强任务失败后重试时，由于失败上下文污染导致错误率升高的现象，并推导了五个核心理论结果，在SWE-bench数据上验证了模型准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在多步工具增强任务失败后重试时，失败的尝试通常保留在上下文窗口中，污染下一次尝试并提高每步错误率。这一现象在实践中广泛存在但缺乏形式化处理。
AI.method: 提出CCRM模型：T步工具调用链，每步基础错误率epsilon_0；失败后重试在污染上下文中进行，错误率升高为epsilon_1。推导了成功概率闭式公式、级联开销定理、最优预算分配定理、信息论下界、干净重启优势定理。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified数据上，IID模型高估pass@3达17.4个百分点(98.6% vs 81.2%)，而CCRM拟合误差小于0.001，级联比epsilon_1/epsilon_0=7.1。蒙特卡洛实验验证了所有理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 证实了上下文污染重启现象的严重性，提供了理论框架来量化污染代价并指导最优重试策略设计。
idea_en: A context-contamination-aware retry mechanism for LLM agents that detects failed tool-call steps and clears or resets the context window before initiating a retry, thereby preventing error cascading and reducing per-step error rates back to base level.

An optimal budget allocation method for multi-step tool-augmented LLM tasks that computes the ideal pipeline depth T* and number of retries K* based on contamination error rates, maximizing success probability under a fixed total budget.

A cascade-ratio monitoring system for LLM agent deployments that dynamically measures the ratio epsilon_1/epsilon_0 to detect context contamination severity and trigger context-clearing interventions when the ratio exceeds a threshold.

A context-contaminated restart model (CCRM) based predictive framework that estimates the true probability of success after K retries for multi-step tool-augmented tasks, correcting the over-optimistic estimates from IID models.

一种多步工具增强型LLM任务的最优预算分配方法：基于污染错误率计算理想流水线深度T*和重试次数K*，在固定总预算下最大化成功概率
